title: LinkedInCaptionContentGeneration
description: CLI-facing twin of ../linkedin_caption.schema.json, used ONLY for the `claude --json-schema` flag that constrains prompts/claude/v1/linkedin_caption.md's generation. See schemas/generation/solve.gen-schema.json's description for why this avoids minLength/maxLength/minItems/maxItems (stated in descriptions instead) and ARCHITECTURE.md 'Why two schema files per stage'. The full shape is enforced after generation by src/claude/validator.py's validate_schema() against ../linkedin_caption.schema.json.

solution_summary.description: 1-3 plain-English sentences on the approach/key insight, written for a LinkedIn feed.

similar_problems.description: 0-3 items, each {title, reason}. Only include problems you're genuinely confident are real LeetCode problems under that exact title -- omit rather than invent.

reason.description: Short phrase, max 80 chars, e.g. 'same sliding-window technique'.

hashtags.description: 4-6 strings, each starting with '#', no spaces.
